article.headline: LIV Golf's October 25 Deadline Has Passed — What Happens Now?

research.facts:
LIV Golf October 25 Deadline
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM — all sources are pre-deadline):**
- October 25, 2026: Deadline for players to commit to LIV 2.0 restructuring (confirmed: multiple sources)
- The date was extended from October 13 to October 25
- PIF (Saudi Arabia's PIF) confirmed only funding LIV through 2026 season
- BC Partners Credit: Initial investment announced; seeking $300M restructuring package contingent on player "critical mass"
- Players who said NO to LIV 2.0 (as of mid-October): Jon Rahm, Adrian Meronk, David Puig
- Players who publicly committed (as of mid-October): Richard Bland, Cameron Tringale, Brendan Steele, Ben Campbell
- Ian Poulter: uncertain about future
- DP World Tour: warned players cannot hold dual membership in 2027
**Context:**
- Jon Rahm won three straight LIV individual titles in 2026 (Indianapolis season finale)
- LIV Golf 2026 had 14 scheduled events
- LIV's restructuring announcement said "critical mass" needed; deadline described as "soft" by Golf Channel sources
**Confidence note:** The actual outcome of the October 25 deadline is not yet confirmed from web search (searches returned pre-deadline articles only). Treating the deadline-has-passed angle as confirmed; player commitments are MEDIUM confidence.
